# CHAPTER XVIIOf Religion by the Threefold Kinds of Faith

Arjuna. If men forsake the holy ordinance,Heedless of Shastras, yet keep faith at heartAnd worship, what shall be the state of those,Great Krishna! Sattwan, Rajas, Tamas? Say!
